prompt: A full-size speedlight with a deep battery housing, a tall neck, and a wide flash head with rounded side cheeks, plus a rear control panel with several raised buttons around a small screen. the head cradle keeps the support geometry exposed instead of hiding it inside the shell, and the button bank remains clearly articulated in the back shell. The neck swivels continuously on a vertical axis above the body and the head rotates on a horizontal tilt hinge at the top of the neck, and each rear-panel button is an independent small prismatic push control. Professional speedlight scale.
